personality_one_liner: A friendly, touchable, and highly visual creation space with soft pastel grounding and vibrant floral accents.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and comfortable margins. Elements should feel slightly buoyant and modular.

do's: Floating action rails in the editor screen
Sticky headers when scrolling through templates
Tab bar base when scrolling Gallery behind it
dont's: Don't blur dense tool panels in the editor, keep them readable.
No blur on empty state illustrations

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A welcoming dashboard to discover floral templates and quickly jump into creation modes.

states.loading: Skeleton grids for templates with a central brand-colored spinner.
states.empty: No templates available yet - large playful floral SVG.
states.error: Failed to load templates. 'Oops, the flowers didn't bloom' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Large hero section with 2 side-by-side chunky action cards ('AI Bloom', 'Photo Edit'). Below, a masonry or 2-column grid of trending floral templates. Use surfaceSecondary for cards with shadow tier 2 on a surface background.

screens.name: Editor
screens.purpose: Full-screen canvas for applying frames, stickers, and editing photos.

states.empty: No photo selected. Prominent buttons to 'Open Camera' or 'Gallery' centered on screen.
states.error: Failed to load image. Retry button.

screens.layout: Image preview takes up maximum safe area. Top floating glass header for 'Cancel' and 'Share'. Bottom features a horizontal scrolling tool rail (Crop, Frames, Stickers, Text). Selecting a tool opens a contextual @gorhom/bottom-sheet or rail directly above the tabs for detailed choices.

screens.name: AIGenerator
screens.purpose: Prompt-based AI flower background and post generation.

states.loading: Large pulsing placeholder with a playful 'Planting seeds...' text and spinner.
states.empty: Input prompt is empty. Display inspiration chips.
states.error: AI generation failed. Prompt user to try a different phrase.

screens.layout: Large text input area at the top with surfaceTertiary background. Below it, a horizontally scrolling row of style chips (Watercolor, Minimal, Vintage). A massive, pill-shaped 'Generate' CTA pinned to the bottom (sticky thumb zone).

screens.name: Gallery
screens.purpose: Showcase user's saved edits and generated floral images.

states.empty: Playful illustration of an empty vase. 'Your garden is empty. Start creating!' with a primary CTA.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Edited vs AI Generated). 2-column grid of images. Each image card has a soft shadow. Full bleed image inside the card container.

template_1.alt: A white sheet of paper surrounded by vibrant flowers

pastel_flower.alt: Pastel pink spring flowers in tilt shift lens

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Blue and purple hues are completely banned. Use the defined coral/peach/charcoal combinations.
Implement the 'Tactile / Playful' layout: use generous padding, chunky pill buttons (radius pill), and soft shadows (tier 2) on cards.
Ensure sticky buttons at the bottom for major actions (e.g., 'Generate' in AI screen) use the thumb-zone pattern, layered above scrolling content.
The Editor screen MUST have a full-screen canvas preview with safe-area spacing. Overlay floating glass headers/footers for tools.
Any text displayed on top of background images MUST use the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the system UI (e.g. empty states, button icons). Use Phosphor icons or real floral SVGs/illustrations.
Do NOT use pure white cards on a pure white background. Ensure contrast between surface and surfaceSecondary.
